faqs.question: What is the Arium Pro used for?
faqs.answer: It's a modular ultrapure water purification system that meets and exceeds ASTM Type 1 standards, used across HPLC, GC-MS, PCR, cell culture, and other demanding analytical applications.

faqs.question: What configurations are available?
faqs.answer: Four core systems: arium® pro (Basic), pro UF (with ultrafilter), pro UV (with UV lamp), and pro VF (UV lamp plus ultrafilter), with an optional TOC monitor on UV and VF models.

faqs.question: What TOC level does Arium Pro achieve?
faqs.answer: Under 2 ppb with the UV lamp option, or under 5 ppb on the UF and Basic configurations.

faqs.question: What does the ultrafilter remove?
faqs.answer: Endotoxins, microorganisms, particles, DNase, and RNase, using advanced crossflow technology.

faqs.question: Does the system monitor water quality in real time?
faqs.answer: Yes, an optionally integrated TOC monitor continuously checks and displays TOC readings in real time on UV and VF configurations.

faqs.question: Is the display easy to use with lab gloves?
faqs.answer: Yes, the glass touch display with intuitive menu navigation is designed for error-free operation while wearing gloves.

faqs.question: Which configuration suits cell culture work?
faqs.answer: arium® pro UF or VF, since both include the crossflow ultrafilter that removes endotoxins, DNase, and RNase.

faqs.question: Can the system be wall-mounted?
faqs.answer: Yes, wall-mounted installation is available on select UV and VF models, alongside benchtop options.

faqs.question: How is Arium Pro different from Arium Mini Plus?
faqs.answer: Arium Pro offers a genuinely modular range of five configurations with options like UV lamps, crossflow ultrafiltration, and real-time TOC monitoring, positioned for more demanding analytical applications than the compact, single-configuration Arium Mini Plus.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Arium Pro in India?
faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote based on the configuration, UV, VF, UF, or Basic, needed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the Arium Pro in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Sartorius Arium Pro in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

Arium Pro solves that with genuine modular design, letting a UV lamp, ultrafilter, and TOC monitor combine exactly as the application demands, across five distinct configurations built on the same core platform. body.text: Every Arium Pro system meets and exceeds the ASTM Type 1 standard, ensuring best-in-class reproducibility of results across demanding analytical applications.
The range is genuinely modular, unlike competitive systems, letting components combine exactly to the application rather than forcing a fixed configuration.
Four core system types are available: arium® pro (essential/Basic), arium® pro UF (with ultrafilter), arium® pro UV (with integrated UV lamp), and arium® pro VF (UV lamp plus ultrafilter combined).
A 185/254 nm UV lamp, available as an option, prevents microbiological growth and minimizes total organic compounds, bringing TOC down to under 2 ppb.
An optionally integrated TOC monitor checks and displays TOC readings continuously in real time, purpose-built for this ultrapure water system.

A built-in ultrafilter using advanced crossflow technology reliably removes endotoxins, microorganisms, particles, DNase, and RNase, making the ultrafiltered configurations well suited to cell cultivation work.
A glass display with touch-activated functions and intuitive menu navigation ensures error-free operation, even while wearing lab gloves.
Additional standard features include a choice of dispensing options, data-saving and printout functions, and color-coded alert messaging.
Installation options span benchtop and wall-mounted configurations, depending on the specific model chosen.

body: Reproducibility in analytical work depends directly on water purity, and total organic carbon is one of the most sensitive variables to get wrong.
The 185/254 nm UV lamp does double duty: preventing microbiological growth in the system while actively minimizing TOC in the purified water, bringing it down to under 2 ppb.
That low TOC level directly supports reproducibility and reliability across lab results, not just a specification on paper.
The optional TOC monitor closes the loop, checking and displaying TOC readings continuously in real time, so water quality is confirmed at the point of use rather than assumed.
sections.note: Share whether the lab currently documents water TOC as part of its QC process, and how the real-time TOC monitor fits that requirement gets confirmed directly.

items: Not every application needs every feature, and Arium Pro's modular lineup is built specifically to avoid paying for capability the work doesn't require.
arium® pro (Basic) covers the essential performance features needed in a standard lab water purification system, with TOC under 5 ppb.
arium® pro UF adds crossflow ultrafiltration, reliably removing endotoxins, DNase, RNase, microorganisms, and particles, ideal for cell cultivation and other sensitive biological applications.
arium® pro UV adds the 185/254 nm UV lamp instead, bringing TOC down to under 2 ppb and preventing microbial growth, suited to analytical work where organic carbon content matters most.
arium® pro VF combines both, UV lamp and ultrafilter together, for applications demanding the lowest TOC and the most thorough biological contaminant removal in one system.
A TOC monitor can be added to either the UV or VF configuration for continuous, real-time verification of water quality.
